summary: Willis Lease Finance Corp filed an 8-K to announce a routine quarterly dividend of $0.133 per share, adjusted for a prior 3-for-1 stock split. The dividend is payable August 21, 2026, to shareholders of record August 11, 2026. This is an ordinary capital return event, not a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. No unusual terms, advisor, or strategic implications are noted. The filing includes a press release and standard exhibits. There is nothing to watch from a special-situations or risk-arbitrage perspective; the dividend is a routine board-approved distribution.
